Bajar lo que puede estar superado: Move down what may be superseded
Cada aviso «puede estar superado» de un: Each “may be superseded” warning on a fragment or a passage moves it two places down before the ones that go in are chosen, so one with several warnings gives its place to a clean one. Simulate it first with the reference queries.
Pesar menos los términos comunes del bra: Weigh the brain's common terms less
Una palabra que sale en más del 20 % de: A word in more than 20% of a brain's fragments or passages (its subject, for example) is not searched as text in them: only its meaning counts. So a question whose only distinctive word is that one does not bring hundreds of fragments that merely name it. The terms are counted with the daily memory health measurement.
